en: A vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a waterfront settlement. Several small sailing boats are on the water in the foreground. On the shore stand wooden buildings and pavilions, including a long building with a central tower-like roof and a smaller structure on a pier or floating platform. Behind them are trees and a few larger villas on a hill. The caption in red at the top left reads "Uddevalla, Gustafsberg."
